title: get_version
description: Response returned for get_version. It contains reader identity and firmware version information with command execution status.

command.description: Echoes the command name so clients can map this response to the get_version request.

requestId.description: Request identifier copied from the command, used for request and response correlation.

apiVersion.description: API version used to interpret this response payload.

readerVersion.description: Object containing detailed version information about the reader, including firmware version, model, serial number, SKU, company name, manufacturer name, and detailed versions of various components.

response.description: Object containing the response code and description for the get_version command.
